text: A puts in ₹60,000 for 10 months and B puts in ₹80,000 for 6 months. Profit is ₹36,000. Find A's share.
X invests ₹45,000 for 8 months and Y invests ₹60,000 for 9 months. Y's share of the profit is ₹31,500. Find the total profit.
solution: Capital-months 360 : 540 = 2 : 3. Y has 3 of 5 parts, so total = 31,500 × 5 ÷ 3.

text: A, B and C invest ₹36,000, ₹54,000 and ₹90,000 for the same year. Profit is ₹1,08,000. Find C's share.
solution: 36 : 54 : 90 = 2 : 3 : 5, so C gets 5/10 of the profit.

text: A starts with ₹80,000 and withdraws ₹20,000 after 4 months. B keeps ₹70,000 in for the whole year. Profit is ₹82,000. Find A's share.
A starts with ₹50,000. After 3 months B joins with ₹60,000. At the end of the year the profit is ₹57,000. Find A's share.
A invests ₹40,000. B joins after 4 months with ₹50,000 and C joins after 6 months with ₹80,000. Yearly profit is ₹1,02,000. Find B's share.
A and B start with ₹30,000 and ₹20,000. After 6 months C joins with ₹40,000. Year-end profit is ₹70,000. Find B's share.
A starts with ₹1,20,000. After 3 months B joins with some capital. At year end the profit is shared 2 : 1 between A and B. Find B's investment.
P and Q invest in the ratio 3 : 5 and earn ₹96,000. P works and gets 10% of the profit extra. Find P's total.
solution: Commission 9,600. Balance 86,400. P's part of the balance = 3/8 × 86,400 = 32,400. Total 42,000.

text: A invests ₹40,000 and B invests ₹60,000. A manages the business and gets 20% of the profit. Profit is ₹50,000. Find A's total.
solution: Commission 10,000. Balance 40,000 split 2 : 3, so A gets 16,000. Total 26,000.

text: A and B invest in the ratio 1 : 3. A works and gets 12% of the profit extra. B's share is ₹33,000. Find the total profit.
solution: B gets 3/4 of the balance, which is 88% of the profit: 0.75 × 0.88 = 0.66. Profit = 33,000 ÷ 0.66 = 50,000.

text: A, B and C invest in the ratio 2 : 3 : 5. A and B work and get 5% and 7% of the profit respectively. Profit is ₹1,00,000. Find B's total.
P keeps 20 sheep for 6 months and Q keeps 18 sheep for 5 months. The rent is ₹8,400. Find Q's share.
X keeps 8 horses for 3 months and 10 cows for 4 months. Y keeps 12 cows for 5 months. 2 horses eat as much as 3 cows. The rent is ₹6,800. Find X's share.
A keeps 12 cows for 5 months, B keeps 18 goats for 6 months and C keeps 8 cows for 9 months. 3 cows eat as much as 5 goats. Total rent is ₹16,400. Find B's share.
solution: 1 cow = 5/3 goat. A = 100, B = 108, C = 120 goat-months. B pays 108/328.

text: X keeps 6 cows for 4 months and 12 goats for 3 months. Y keeps 20 sheep for 6 months. 2 cows eat as much as 5 goats, and 3 goats as much as 4 sheep. The rent is ₹18,600. Find X's share.
